syllabus_topics: Amplification stages: elementary configurations; Incremental scheme; Frequency response.
Differential amplification stages with multiple stages
Structure of an operational amplifier or transconductance amplifier (AMPOP and OTA).
Other power electronic and optoelectronic devices.
CMOS logic gates (primitive, complex, pass-through, tri-state logic).
Introduction to Digital Electronic Systems Design.
assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) is the maximum of the normal season grade (NFN), the resit season grade (NFR), or the special season grade (NFE). For the normal season, NFN = 0.2 * MAP30 + 0.3 * L + 0.5 * EN, with a minimum grade of 8 for EN and 9.5 for L. For the resit season, NFR = 0.3 * L + 0.7 * ER, with a minimum grade of 8 for ER. For the special season, NFE = 0.3 * L + 0.7 * EE. Attendance at all laboratory sessions is mandatory. Fraudulent activity will result in the annulment of all involved assessments and will be reported.
